dataset.name: ATOM3D Ligand Binding Affinity, 30 percent sequence-identity split
dataset.target: pK = -log(K), with Ki or Kd depending on the source record
dataset.license: CC BY-NC-ND; original data and derivatives are not redistributed

v2_0_boundary.interpretation: Historical ATOM3D experiments belong to earlier exploratory branches and are not part of the frozen V2.0 checkpoint evidence.

official_test_scored_once_by_separate_ea.model: Separate 3343D, 175-tree LightGBM experiment with three seeds; not the V2.0 checkpoint
official_test_scored_once_by_separate_ea.interpretation: The native point estimate is lower, but the prespecified geometry-specific comparisons against pocket-only and shuffled geometry are inconclusive. The no-pocket 2D comparison does not isolate geometry from the addition of bound-pocket information.

historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Pooled scratch-3D advantage reversed under equal-protein-group macro RMSE; pose-pretrained transfer was worse.
Matched-capacity fine-geometry arms were nearly tied; the paired interval crossed zero. The separate 2D baseline was not capacity/feature matched.

Pocket-only was numerically best; all five paired group-bootstrap intervals in the archived analysis crossed zero. A separate frozen-weight test established geometry-input sensitivity, not affinity superiority.

historical_train_only_experiments.design: Four heuristic protein-component-disjoint folds; five matched 3343D LightGBM arms
historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Native beat pocket-only on the group-macro comparison, but native-versus-shuffled uncertainty crossed zero.

historical_train_only_experiments.design: Fixed V27 native-trained weights with geometry-only donor/shuffle interventions
historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Evidence of learned pair-specific feature sensitivity; donor hybrids were partly out of range and were not guaranteed physically valid poses.

historical_train_only_experiments.design: Murcko-scaffold-disjoint source TRAIN folds; protein groups overlap
historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Promising retrospective scaffold-cold result, but protein groups were not held out.

historical_train_only_experiments.design: Post-hoc filter of frozen V30 predictions; both scaffold and heuristic protein component absent from fitting
historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Native-versus-shuffled intervals crossed zero on the stricter dual-cold subset; native-versus-pocket-only was more favorable but remains retrospective.

historical_train_only_experiments.design: Morgan plus frozen ESM-2 35M; source TRAIN scaffold folds
historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Pretrained ESM2 35M improved the source baseline, but the native-specific geometry contrast was inconclusive; shuffled was numerically better on the stricter dual-cold subset. ESM2 35M is not the V2.0 ESM2 650M tower.

historical_train_only_experiments.design: Rigid-body and near-native ligand-coordinate perturbations with steric screening
historical_train_only_experiments.interpretation: Pose sensitivity was measurable on source scaffold-cold folds, but strict dual-cold comparisons had intervals crossing zero. V35 showed that most large pose perturbations failed the steric screen; V36 near-native perturbations did not establish a robust dual-cold affinity benefit.

claim_boundaries: No V2.0 ATOM3D score is established.
No ATOM3D result here is an untouched or prospective V2.0 validation.
The one-time official test must not be reread or rescored.
No universal 3D superiority or published PerceiverCPI, HeteroDTA or SISDTA win is established.
The historical native-structure experiments require experimentally bound complexes; they do not demonstrate pose-free SMILES-plus-sequence 3D inference.
